newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish EAC in Eastman graphics deal.
newsitem.headline: Danish EAC in Eastman graphics deal.

text.p: Danish trading group East Asiatic Company (EAC) said on Monday that its graphics unit had signed an Asian and African marketing agreement with U.S. film giant Eastman Kodak, to take effect during 1997.

An EAC statement said that the agreement, covering more than 40 countries, would give Eastman Kodak access to the Danish group's distribution network for its films, plates and other supplies to the graphics industry.

It said that EAC, the biggest distributor of graphics supplies in Africa and Asia, saw the deal as a chance to expand its share of a market it estimated as worth six billion crowns. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
